subject: TEST RESULT: readiness-gated visual admission model passes 14/14 + 100k adversarial
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-research-rd-1-readiness-revocation-20261002. Source-faithful baseline reproduces the ownership gap: after an admitted COVER_VISUAL host, exact current Fold7CoverReadiness can fall READY->WAITING_ROUTE while baseline visual demand/host ownership remains retained. Corrected model separates semantic visual demand from readiness-gated host admission: route loss revokes host immediately but keeps same-cycle demand; only a fresh exact-current READY observation re-admits; shell mutation completion alone cannot re-admit; stale old-cycle/lease-epoch READY or DROP events are inert; reversal/native takeover clears authority. Focused tests 14/14 PASS. Fixed-seed adversarial 100,000 events PASS with invariant host_admitted => current active owner && visual demand && readiness READY. No production writes.
